description: This file defines the LanguageHelper class, which provides utility functions for managing language strings, language packs, and database interactions related to internationalization within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: LanguageHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing language strings, language packs, and their database representations, facilitating internationalization features within the system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LanguageHelper with a database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the database connection used by the helper.

methods.name: readLangStrings
methods.description: Reads language strings from a YAML file and associates them with a specific group, returning an array of LangString objects.

methods.name: getGroupIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the database ID for a given language group name, caching the result for future calls.

methods.name: deleteLangStringByUnitId
methods.description: Deletes language strings from the database based on their unit ID, optionally filtered by group ID.

methods.name: insertTranslation
methods.description: Inserts or updates a translation for a specific language string ID and language ID.

methods.name: getLanguageIdByLangCode
methods.description: Fetches the database ID for a language code, or null if not found.

methods.name: updateLanguageStatusByLangCode
methods.description: Enables or disables a language based on its code, marking it as added or not.

methods.name: createTestLanguagePack
methods.description: Creates a test language pack with dummy translations for testing internationalization features.

methods.name: deleteTestLanguagePack
methods.description: Deletes the test language pack from the database.
